EchoColony.XenotypeAIPromptDef.promptDescription: A predatory arachnid xenohuman capable of rapidly producing synthetic silk, hunting with relentless speed and pouncing agility.
An engineered arachnid xenohuman capable of spinning high-grade devilstrand silk, tempered with a calm, civil temperament.
A mysterious, deceptive shape-shifting xenohuman capable of altering biological forms and infiltrating societies with uncanny adaptability.
A grotesque, genetically unstable chimera created in illicit gene labs, possessing chaotic physical mutations and relentless vitality.
A colossal, continuously growing maternal chimera capable of gestating diverse biological litters, whose body expands unstoppably with age.
A diminutive parasitic xenohuman specialized in biological manipulation and thriving as an elusive, manipulative symbiote.
A genetically engineered insectoid matriarch and hive queen, bearing insectoid mandibles, antennae, and pheromone organs to command and nurture offspring across species.
